question.prompt: A bag contains 5 red balls, 3 white balls, and 2 yellow balls (all of the same shape). If one ball is drawn at random, how do the likelihoods of drawing a red, white, or yellow ball rank from greatest to least? (Connect them with “＞”.)

solutions.explanation: The numbers of the three types of balls are 5, 3, and 2, respectively. The more balls of a type there are, the more likely that type is to be drawn, so red ball＞white ball＞yellow ball.
solutions.title: Order the color counts
